about_the_game:
"Tipsy Cat," you become the owner of a bar and spend leisurely time with a regular female customer, "Kitten," and unique customers. The customers who visit the bar change depending on the music you play. Choose your favorite music.

Game Description

This game is a choice-based adventure novel. The story branches depending on the music and the master's lines. There are multiple routes with short scenarios of about 20 minutes per playthrough. Each story introduces the characters, delves deeper, and allows you to enjoy the world in which they live.

Worldview of the Game

The setting is a bar called Tipcy Cat, which might exist somewhere in the modern world. Customers—some burdened with worries, some not—visit the bar each day. The bar owner is fond of records and seems to buy new ones almost daily.

Koneko

A regular at Tipcy Cat. She seems to be an ordinary working adult with a proper daytime job.

She appears in almost every story in the game and is a cherished guest, practically part of the staff.

Cocktails

At this bar, it’s customary to give the cocktails unique and creative names.

Surprise your guests with charming names and make them smile.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains scenes of alcoholic beverages being served, and depictions that imply sexual activity.

short_description: Tipcy Cat is a choice-based adventure novel game. The game progresses by players choosing which records to play that day. Records are either drawn by lottery or purchased with in-game currency, so players can choose their records in a variety of ways. Enjoy the novel part along with the music.
